cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you retire, tell the committee I'm in charge now. I taught you to run this hall; show me you can hand it back properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's the key. My taxi's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've remembered the key. You forgot the people. Say who's making the decisions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're outside asking me whether to cancel Saturday's dance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect practice. Tell them I decide, then ask me about the dance in front of them. You've spent years using my training; give me one clear handover sentence before you go.

reason: Use the claimed pupil relationship to shape the precise authority pursuit, keeping each partner response an actual cause of the next tactic.
